title: Code length through procedure bodies
statement: For every program $P$, main procedure index $p_0$, and Boolean flag $d$, concatenate the head code, main code, and code for all procedure bodies in the layout determined by $P$ and $d$. The resulting list has length equal to the dispatcher position determined by $P$ and $d$.
